title: Chinna Durai
desc: Chinnadurai, a village do-gooder, helps people in distress but earns the enmity of a fellow villager Ponnambalam. Later, Ponnambalam tries to poison Chinnadurai, but he survives.

title: Veera Padhakkam
desc: A corrupt, ambitious policeman is forced to mend his ways after witnessing the consequences of his role in a relative's life.

title: Vithagan
desc: Rowdhiran, a tough and honest cop, seeks revenge on a criminal gang. However, when Badri, the mob boss, plots his downfall, Rowdhiran decides to go down swinging.

title: Veetla Visheshanga
desc: A widower helps a woman by admitting her to the hospital. However, complications arise when the doctor convinces her that he is her husband.
